subject: player/object collision geometry audit

evidence_classes.DECODED DATA: ROM tables/records decoded by a parser
evidence_classes.BYTE-VERIFIED ASSEMBLY: routine bytes compared literally and disassembled by hand
evidence_classes.SOURCE-TRACED BEHAVIOR: behavior read from the disassembly, not executed
evidence_classes.CONTROLLED ROUTINE RESULT: original routine executed on a Z80 core with explicit RAM

extent_fields.evidence: BYTE-VERIFIED (opcode scan of the whole ROM)
extent_fields.conclusion: $D52C/$D52D are read only by the overlap helpers ($6328 at $6359/$6377/$6398, the unused variant at $643B/$6459/$6478) and by the solid helper $5FA0 ($5FE1, $6024, $6053); they are written only by the animation engine ($6595/$659A) for the player slot. No player state setter, terrain routine or object routine writes them. The other IX/IY writes ($3266, $1B83, $1BC6, $7A4A4/$7A4A8) belong to other objects (HUD/effects and the bank-$1E small projectile).

overlap_6328.evidence: BYTE-VERIFIED ASSEMBLY + CONTROLLED ROUTINE RESULT (grid in `overlap_grid`)
overlap_6328.address: 0x6328 (fixed bank 1, vector $033B); variants: $630B (+ damage request, vector $0434), $640B (no direct caller)

inputs.object: IX: +$11/+$12 X, +$14/+$15 Y (16-bit world anchors), +$2C X extent, +$2D Y extent, +$03 flags
inputs.player: $D511 X, $D514 Y (16-bit anchors), $D52C X extent, $D52D Y extent, $D503 flags

gates: +$03 bit 7 clear and $D503 bit 6 set: no test
(the sign, and the boss state 3, set +$03 bit 7 to ignore the player's bit-6 gate)

rule.dx: dx = playerX - objectX as an UNSIGNED 16-bit subtraction. No borrow: need dx <= 255 and dx <= (playerExtX + objectExtX) & $FF. Borrow: need objectX - playerX in 1..255 (256 fails because NEG 0 = 0) and objectX - playerX <= (playerExtX + objectExtX) & $FF.
rule.dy: dy = playerY - objectY, same unsigned scheme. No borrow (player at/below the object anchor): dy <= 255 and dy <= playerExtY ($D52D) ONLY. Borrow (player above): objectY - playerY in 1..255 and <= objectExtY (+$2D) ONLY.
rule.edges: all comparisons are inclusive (<=). A player exactly at dx = 0 or dy = 0 takes the no-borrow branch.
rule.interval_form: equivalent to overlap of the closed intervals player X [px-ExtX, px+ExtX] x Y [py-ExtY, py] with object X [ox-oExtX, ox+oExtX] x Y [oy-oExtY, oy]; i.e. both boxes hang ABOVE their anchors, the player box is 2*ExtX+1 wide and ExtY+1 tall, the anchor is the bottom edge of both boxes
rule.wrap: sums are 8-bit: ExtX + objectExtX wraps modulo 256 (no real extent reaches that); any |d| >= 256 fails; positions compare as unsigned 16-bit, so a wrapped world coordinate near $FFFF/0 behaves as a huge distance

outputs.+$20: 1 when $D503 bit 7 is clear and the test passed, else 0 (always cleared at entry)
outputs.+$21: low nibble: bit0 player above, bit1 player below, bit2 player right (dx >= 0), bit3 player left; on success only the axis of minimum penetration survives (horizontal if hPen < vPen, vertical on ties) and the HIGH nibble is cleared; on failure the high nibble is kept and the low nibble is 0
outputs.$D520: slot id ((IX - $D500) >> 6) + 1 when +$03 bit 7 is clear and the test passed
outputs.$D521: low nibble kept; high nibble = (+$21 low nibble) XOR (12 if the surviving axis is horizontal else 3): the mirrored contact from the object's side
outputs.return_convention: none: callers test (IX+$21) & $0F. Registers are not a convention (A holds the last byte written).

overlap_6328.penetration: hPen = (playerExtX + objectExtX) - |dx|; vPen = (playerExtY - dy) for dy >= 0 else (objectExtY - |dy|). Bit choice: horizontal iff hPen < vPen.

grid.evidence: CONTROLLED ROUTINE RESULT (original $6328 vs reference model)

solid_5FA0.evidence: BYTE-VERIFIED ASSEMBLY + CONTROLLED ROUTINE RESULT (grid in `solid_grid`)
solid_5FA0.address: 0x5FA0 (fixed bank 1, vector $034D): CALL $6328, then a 16-entry jump table at $5FB9 indexed by the +$21 low nibble

dispatch.0 / combined bits: RET (the overlap helper leaves exactly one bit, so combinations do not occur)

actions.player_above: unless $D523 bit 0 is set: playerY = objectY - objectExtY (+$2D): the player's anchor is placed ON the object's top edge
actions.player_below: unless $D523 bit 1 is set: playerY = objectY + playerExtY ($D52D)
actions.player_right: unless $D523 bit 2 is set and only while playerX <= cameraX + $E0: playerX = objectX + objectExtX + playerExtX
actions.player_left: unless $D523 bit 3 is set and only while playerX > cameraX + $20: playerX = objectX - (objectExtX + playerExtX)

consumes.player_extents: $D52C in both side pushes, $D52D only in the 'below' push (and, through $6328, in the dy >= 0 test)
consumes.object_extents: +$2C in both side pushes, +$2D in the 'above' push (and in the dy < 0 test)
consumes.camera: $D174 (side pushes are suppressed near the screen edges)
consumes.flags: $D523 (combined player contact flags: a push is skipped when the player is already blocked on that side)

solid_5FA0.tie_behavior: inherited from $6328: horizontal wins only when hPen < vPen; an exact tie selects the vertical axis
solid_5FA0.velocity_and_state: NONE. $5FA0 writes no velocity, no player state, no floor flag and does not set the player's grounded bit; callers (type $10 at $A177) handle bounces, rewards and state themselves. Standing on a solid object therefore depends on the caller and on the next terrain update.

sprite.name: SPR_player_mask
sprite.used_by: OBJ_player_char, OBJ_player_char_spin and the other player objects (one constant mask)

poc_player_mask.formula: chaosAnchorOffset = 18 - (bbox_bottom - yorigin); ROM anchor Y = POC y - chaosAnchorOffset; foot = ROM anchor + 18 = bbox_bottom
poc_player_mask.note: The ROM overlap helpers treat the player as the closed box x [-8,+8], y [-24,0] around the anchor (object boxes hang above the object anchor in the same way); the POC mask is 11 px wide and reaches from 12 px above to 18 px below the ROM anchor. The two are not the same region, so a mask overlap is not equivalent to the ROM test even where the dimensions look similar.

player_extents.method: for every player state 0..$33 the state script is run through the real engine with the player slot ($D500); $D52C/$D52D are read after each record load. Run-frame selectors see speeds 0, $0100, $0300, $0600 and -$0300.

emulated_player_extents.method: THZ1 from the start, pseudo-random input every 20 frames; ($D501, $D52C, $D52D) sampled after every frame

helper_matrix.evidence: SOURCE-TRACED BEHAVIOR (recursive descent over the real state-script callbacks; the animation engine is executed to obtain them)

callback_sweeps.evidence: CONTROLLED ROUTINE RESULT (real callbacks, Sonic extents (8,24), velocity set so the object does not move first)
callback_sweeps.note: Rows whose callback first moves the object (type $28) differ from the formula by that one-pixel move; all others match exactly.

spring_26.rule: after $82AF requires: +$04 bit 6 clear, $D519 bit 7 clear (not moving up), $D522 bit 1 set (floor contact), requested state != $21; |playerX - objectX| < 12 (STRICT, vector $0383 -> $61A5 with BC = 12); 0 <= (objectY - 28) - playerY < 6, i.e. playerY in [objectY-33, objectY-28]. Object X/Y are the runtime anchor (+$11/+$14).

proximity.rule: $61A5/$61B1/$61BB: hit (A = $FF) iff |d| < BC (strict). $617E: |dx| < 12 and |dy| < 12 on the two anchors, no extents.
